idea: An AI study planner app for JEE aspirants that adjusts the timetable after every mock test

strategist.problem: A JEE aspirant finishes a mock test, sees a score drop, and has no idea which chapters to reschedule — the weekly timetable they made on Sunday is already stale by Monday morning.
strategist.target_customer: Parents of class 11 and 12 JEE aspirants in Indian metros and tier-2 cities, household income ₹6-25 lakh, who already pay ₹1,000-3,000/month for coaching and buy anything that makes their child's study hours accountable.
strategist.mission: Turn every mock test result into a revised, dated study timetable for JEE aspirants so parents can see their child's plan adapt instead of going stale.

competitors.name: Coaching institute in-house study planners (Allen, FIITJEE, Aakash doubt and progress portals)
competitors.differentiator: Their portals log attendance and marks but don't rewrite a dated weekly timetable; we regenerate the plan within minutes of each mock.

competitors.name: Generic AI timetable apps and Notion/Excel study planner templates
competitors.differentiator: They take manual input and never touch mock scores; we ingest the test result and auto-rebalance chapter slots.

competitors.name: Personal tutors and academic mentors in India
competitors.differentiator: A tutor costs ₹2,000-10,000/month for one subject; we cover PCM with an always-on replan at a fraction of that.

scope_cuts: Skip building a question bank or mock test engine — students already write mocks on coaching portals and PyQ apps; we only ingest the score sheet.
Skip a native Android/iOS build in v1; ship a mobile-web app first so a solo student founder can ship inside 4 weeks.
Skip doubt-solving, video lectures and chat with peers — those are coaching products, not the replan loop we're selling.

stack.name: Next.js
stack.why: App Router + Tailwind for a mobile-web planner that regenerates dated timetables after each mock.

stack.name: Supabase
stack.why: Postgres stores student profiles, mock scores and timetable slots; auth handles parent/student login on free tier.

stack.name: Netlify
stack.why: Free tier hosts the Next.js app commercially without Vercel Pro cost.

stack.name: Razorpay
stack.why: UPI + payment links for ₹-denominated monthly parent subscriptions in India.

stack.name: Resend
stack.why: Free tier sends parent-facing weekly plan summary and replan emails.

stack.name: Domain
stack.why: One .in address for the landing page parents land on from WhatsApp.

ai_tools.name: Gemini API
ai_tools.why: Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite free tier parses mock score sheets and rewrites chapter-wise timetable slots cheaply.

ai_tools.name: Claude
ai_tools.why: Free tier writes replan prompts, landing copy and onboarding scripts for the solo student founder.

ai_tools.name: ChatGPT
ai_tools.why: Free tier drafts JEE chapter taxonomy and timetable templates the app seeds from.

mvp_features: Upload or paste a mock test score sheet; app auto-rebalances the next 7-day dated chapter timetable within minutes (core paid moment).
Parent dashboard showing this week's plan, last mock score and what changed after replan.
Razorpay subscription checkout with UPI payment link and webhook-gated access.

first_10_steps: Run `npx create-next-app@latest jee-replan --ts --tailwind --app` and push to a GitHub repo.
Create a Supabase project; add tables `students`, `mock_tests`, `chapter_scores`, `timetable_slots`.
Sign up for Gemini API free tier; write a prompt that maps a score sheet JSON to a 7-day chapter timetable.
Build the score-sheet upload form and call Gemini to render the revised timetable on `/dashboard`.
Add Supabase Auth email login for student and parent roles on one shared household.
Build the parent view showing last mock score, old plan vs new plan diff.
Sign up for Razorpay Standard; create a ₹ subscription plan and a payment link; wire the webhook to unlock replan.
Send the Resend email template: weekly plan summary to parent every Sunday 8 PM IST.
Deploy to Netlify free tier; connect the .in domain bought at ₹75/mo.
Post the live link in 3 class and hostel WhatsApp groups and DM 10 batchmate parents with the Razorpay link.

key_assumptions: Parents of class 11-12 JEE students already paying ₹1,000-3,000/month for coaching will pay ₹399/month for accountable replanning — assumption from strategist target_customer.
Delivery cost of ₹25/customer = Gemini Flash-Lite replan calls (~₹15) plus Resend emails (~₹10) at free/low tiers.
Founder contributes 15 hours/week personally; no freelancer cost counted in delivery.
Free-tier Supabase, Resend, Gemini, PostHog, WhatsApp Business, ChatGPT, Claude cover all usage below 30 paying customers.

channels.name: Class 11/12 JEE parent WhatsApp groups + DMs
channels.tactic: Join 10 parent WhatsApp groups (school alumni, coaching batch parents, society groups); post 1 replan demo screenshot + Razorpay link to 3 groups/day; DM 10 parents/day from group rosters.

channels.name: Instagram reels to JEE parent audience in metros/tier-2
channels.tactic: Post 1 reel/day showing old plan vs replanned timetable after a mock; reply to 20 comments/DMs daily; ₹500/day Boost on the top 3 reels only.

first_10_customers: Day 1-3: Ask 5 relatives/family friends with class 11-12 kids for their parent's WhatsApp number; send the cold message and offer a free 2-week replan pilot on their child's last mock score.
Day 4-7: Join 3 coaching-class parent broadcast groups via a batchmate in Allen/FIITJEE/Aakash; post one before/after timetable screenshot with the Razorpay ₹399 link.
Day 8-14: DM 10 parents per day on Instagram from JEE-related reels comments; offer a free replan of one real score sheet as proof before asking for payment.
Day 15-21: Call the 5 pilot parents, show their child's week-2 replan diff, ask for ₹399 monthly directly via UPI payment link.
Day 22-30: Ask each paying parent to forward the link to 2 parents in their coaching batch; give referrer 1 free month (revenue reduction, not spend).
growth.cold_message:
Namaste, I'm a student building an app that rewrites your child's 7-day JEE timetable within minutes of every mock test score.
Send me one recent mock score sheet — I'll send back a revised dated plan free, no payment.
If it's useful, it's ₹399/month with UPI; cancel anytime.

objections.objection: Coaching already gives my child a study plan.
objections.response: Their plan is fixed at admission; ours rewrites chapter slots within minutes of each mock score sheet — send one score sheet and see the diff free.

objections.objection: ₹399/month is too much on top of coaching fees.
objections.response: It's ₹13/day, less than a single doubt-class handout; first 2 weeks are free on your child's real mock so you pay only after seeing the replan work.

critic.verdict: The plan stays true to the AI study planner for JEE aspirants with a parent-paid subscription, and the build stack, free tiers and bootstrapped budget all fit the hard rules. The biggest weak spot is realism: converting 15 paying parents in 60 days through cold WhatsApp/Instagram outreach with no track record is optimistic, and the ₹399 price point is untested with this audience. Overall it's a coherent, shippable plan with a plausible path to first revenue but aggressive growth targets.
critic.biggest_risk: Cold WhatsApp and Instagram outreach to parents who don't know the founder may yield far fewer than 15 paying customers by day 60, leaving the plan below break-even longer than the 6.2-month runway assumes.
